description: Call this tool to write a .ics for one meeting and return the path plus the start in UTC and in your zone. Times are stored in UTC so it lands correctly in any client. Free: 3 files a month.

attendees.description: Attendees. An entry with an email is invited (ATTENDEE:mailto:...); a name with no email is listed in the description instead, because a calendar cannot invite a name.

fold.description: Which occurrence of a time that happens twice because the clocks went back. Default 'first'.

gap.description: What to do with a time that does not exist because the clocks jumped forward: 'forward' takes the time after the jump, 'backward' the time before it. Without this, such a time is refused.

organizer_email.description: Your email address, written as the ORGANIZER so replies have somewhere to go. Leave it out and your shared business profile's email is used; with neither, the ORGANIZER line is omitted rather than filled with an address you improvised

organizer_name.description: Your display name for the ORGANIZER line

out_path.description: Name for the downloaded file, default meeting.ics

start.description: Start time, read in `zone` unless it carries an offset

zone.description: Place the start time is given in

name: ics_create
title: Write a calendar invite
